integrity: Analytic complete proof; exact rational verifier supplements the proof. Unindexed literature remains an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional integration; deterministic positive-width partition, independent reflected uniform pairs, convex globally L-Lipschitz functions; noise extension assumes fresh independent zero-mean equal-variance errors; not optimality over all algorithms. Specialized earlier exact results might exist.
title: Sharp minimax risk and optimal meshes for reflected-pair quadrature of convex Lipschitz functions
